summary: Install the required collections with `ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml`, then run `ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_install --ask-become-pass`; the play recap should show no failures.
questions: Module resolution errors installing automation dashboard
Can the dashboard database be on another host?

answer_card.title: Run the automation dashboard installer
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml   # avoids module resolution errors
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_install --ask-become-pass
```
Check the PLAY RECAP shows `failed=0`.
